title: Add built‑in request body validation middleware
description: Validating incoming JSON payloads prevents runtime errors and security issues. This middleware lets developers declare JSON schemas per route, automatically returning 400 with detailed errors when validation fails, while keeping the zero‑dependency promise.
testCases: Should pass when request body matches the defined schema
Should reject with 400 and a clear error message when body is missing required fields
Should reject with 400 when body contains fields of wrong type
Should ignore validation for routes without a schema
acceptance: All new tests pass, existing test suite remains green, and the middleware correctly validates payloads, returns appropriate HTTP status codes, and logs validation errors without crashing the server.
reason: Improves API reliability and security, reduces boilerplate validation code, and aligns with the framework’s goal of providing production‑ready features out‑of‑the‑box.
